In this section, we fit **Model 2** as described in the paper, which extends Model 1 by incorporating spatial covariates:

$$\log(\lambda(s)) = \beta_0 + \sum_{i=1}^{11} \beta_i X_i(s) + u(s)$$

where $X_i$ are spatial covariates and $u(s)$ is the Whittle--Matérn field. The covariates include functional road class (FRC, one-hot encoded), speed limit, and log-transformed distances to amenities (education, finance, hospitals, intersections). Details on covariate extraction are in [Extracting Covariates](covariates.html) and [Computing Spatial Covariates](covariates2.html).

We fit the model using the `lgcp_graph` wrapper from the MetricGraph package.

## Data Loading and Graph Preparation

```{r}
library(MetricGraph)
library(INLA)
library(qs)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)

# Load data, graph, and precomputed mesh covariates
data <- qread("Data/data_all_reasons_with_distances_7FRC.qs")
graph <- qread("Data/graph_mesh_pruned_50m_7FRC.qs")
mesh_covariates <- qread("Data/mesh_locations_pruned_50m_with_distances_7FRC.qs")

summary(graph)
```

## Adding Covariates to the Graph

We add the accident observations to the graph and extract edge-level covariates (FRC, speed limit, road length). The length covariate is converted from meters to kilometers for consistency with the distance-to-amenity covariates.

```{r}
# Add raw observations to graph
graph$add_observations(
  data = data, normalized = TRUE, tolerance = 0.6, group = "YearNew",
  clear_obs = TRUE, duplicated_strategy = "jitter"
)

# Create a "Length" covariate (edge length in km)
graph$set_edge_weights(weights = graph$get_edge_weights() %>%
                         mutate(Length = graph$get_edge_lengths()))
data_on_graph <- graph$get_data()
data_on_graph$Length <- data_on_graph$Length / 1000  # convert to km

ss <- graph$get_data()
graph$compute_mesh_weights()
n_accidents <- sum(!is.na(ss$AccidentSeverityId))  # 2482
```

## Preparing Covariates at Mesh Locations

For the `lgcp_graph` wrapper, covariates must be available at both observation and mesh locations. We extract edge weights at mesh nodes using `edgeweight_to_data()` and merge with the precomputed amenity distances.

```{r}
alpha <- 1
atilde <- graph$mesh$weights

# Get covariates at mesh locations from edge weights
data_on_mesh <- graph$edgeweight_to_data(mesh = TRUE, add = FALSE,
                                          return = TRUE, normalized = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::filter(.group == 2015)

# Merge with precomputed amenity distances
data_on_mesh <- merge(data_on_mesh, mesh_covariates,
                       by = c(".edge_number", ".distance_on_edge"))
data_on_mesh <- st_as_sf(data_on_mesh, coords = c("x", "y"), crs = 4326)

YearNew <- unique(data_on_graph$YearNew)
n_accidents <- table(data_on_graph$YearNew)
```

## Normalizing Covariates

All covariates are normalized using min--max scaling applied jointly across observation and mesh locations to ensure consistency. This is important because the covariates must be on comparable scales for the model to fit well.

```{r}
min_max_normalize <- function(x) {
  return((x - min(x)) / (max(x) - min(x)))
}

# Columns to normalize
columns_to_normalize <- c("Length", "SpeedLimit",
                          "log_distance_to_finance", "log_distance_to_hospital",
                          "log_distance_to_intersection", "log_distance_to_education")

# Combine graph and mesh data, normalize jointly, then split back
graph_data <- data_on_graph[, columns_to_normalize]
mesh_data  <- data_on_mesh[, columns_to_normalize]
combined   <- dplyr::bind_rows(graph_data, mesh_data) %>% dplyr::select(-geometry)

for (col in columns_to_normalize) {
  combined[[col]] <- min_max_normalize(combined[[col]])
}

normalized_graph_data <- combined[1:nrow(graph_data), ]
normalized_mesh_data  <- combined[(nrow(graph_data) + 1):nrow(combined), ]
data_on_graph[, columns_to_normalize] <- normalized_graph_data
data_on_mesh[, columns_to_normalize] <- normalized_mesh_data

# Reorder mesh data to match graph$mesh$VtE ordering
data_on_mesh <- match_mesh_data(graph, data_on_mesh)
# Verify ordering:
sum((graph$mesh$VtE - as.matrix(sf::st_drop_geometry(data_on_mesh[, 1:2])))^2)
```

## One-Hot Encoding of FRC

Functional road class (FRC) is encoded as dummy variables. FRC7 is used as the reference category (dropped from the model).

```{r}
road_types_graph_data_dummy <- as.data.frame(model.matrix(~ factor(FRC) - 1, data = data_on_graph))
colnames(road_types_graph_data_dummy) <- c("FRC1", "FRC2", "FRC3", "FRC4", "FRC5", "FRC6", "FRC7")

road_types_graph_mesh_dummy <- as.data.frame(model.matrix(~ factor(FRC) - 1, data = data_on_mesh))
colnames(road_types_graph_mesh_dummy) <- c("FRC1", "FRC2", "FRC3", "FRC4", "FRC5", "FRC6", "FRC7")
```

## Correlation Analysis

Before fitting, we check correlations among covariates to detect multicollinearity. We excluded mosques due to high correlation with other distance covariates.

```{r, eval=TRUE, echo=FALSE}
knitr::include_graphics("Figures/New_5Graph_model2_alpha1_7FRC_pruned_exact_50m_correlation_plot.png")
```

## Adding Observations and Mesh Covariates

We add the observed events and provide the covariates at mesh locations via `manual_covariates`. The wrapper handles integration weights internally.

```{r}
n_total <- sum(n_accidents)
graph$clear_observations()

# Add observed events with covariates
graph$add_observations(
  data = data.frame(
    y = rep(1, n_total),
    Intercept = 1,
    speed_limit = data_on_graph$SpeedLimit,
    road_type1 = road_types_graph_data_dummy$FRC1,
    road_type2 = road_types_graph_data_dummy$FRC2,
    road_type3 = road_types_graph_data_dummy$FRC3,
    road_type4 = road_types_graph_data_dummy$FRC4,
    road_type5 = road_types_graph_data_dummy$FRC5,
    road_type6 = road_types_graph_data_dummy$FRC6,
    log_dist_education    = data_on_graph$log_distance_to_education,
    log_dist_finance      = data_on_graph$log_distance_to_finance,
    log_dist_hospital     = data_on_graph$log_distance_to_hospital,
    log_dist_intersection = data_on_graph$log_distance_to_intersection,
    edge_number = data_on_graph$.edge_number,
    distance_on_edge = data_on_graph$.distance_on_edge
  ),
  normalized = TRUE
)

# Covariates at mesh locations (for integration)
manual_cov <- data.frame(
  Intercept = rep(1, nrow(graph$mesh$VtE)),
  speed_limit = data_on_mesh$SpeedLimit,
  road_type1 = road_types_graph_mesh_dummy$FRC1,
  road_type2 = road_types_graph_mesh_dummy$FRC2,
  road_type3 = road_types_graph_mesh_dummy$FRC3,
  road_type4 = road_types_graph_mesh_dummy$FRC4,
  road_type5 = road_types_graph_mesh_dummy$FRC5,
  road_type6 = road_types_graph_mesh_dummy$FRC6,
  log_dist_education    = data_on_mesh$log_distance_to_education,
  log_dist_finance      = data_on_mesh$log_distance_to_finance,
  log_dist_hospital     = data_on_mesh$log_distance_to_hospital,
  log_dist_intersection = data_on_mesh$log_distance_to_intersection,
  coord_x = graph$mesh$V[,1],
  coord_y = graph$mesh$V[,2],
  edge_number = data_on_mesh$.edge_number,
  distance_on_edge = data_on_mesh$.distance_on_edge,
  .group = 1
)
```

## Fitting Model 2

We build the SPDE model and fit using the `lgcp_graph` wrapper. The formula includes the intercept, speed limit, FRC categories (1--6, with FRC7 as reference), log-distances to amenities, and the Whittle--Matérn field.

```{r}
spde_model <- graph_spde(graph, alpha = 1, LGCP = TRUE, parameterization = "spde")

system.time(fit_model2 <- lgcp_graph(
  y ~ -1 + Intercept + speed_limit +
    road_type1 + road_type2 + road_type3 + road_type4 + road_type5 + road_type6 +
    log_dist_education + log_dist_hospital + log_dist_finance + log_dist_intersection +
    f(field, model = spde_model),
  graph = graph,
  manual_covariates = manual_cov,
  interpolate = FALSE,
  use_current_mesh = TRUE,
  control.compute = list(config = TRUE, waic = TRUE, dic = TRUE, cpo = TRUE),
  control.fixed = list(prec = list(Intercept = 0, speed_limit = 0,
                                    road_type1 = 0, road_type2 = 0, road_type3 = 0,
                                    road_type4 = 0, road_type5 = 0, road_type6 = 0)),
  control.inla = list(control.vb = list(enable = FALSE), int.strategy = "eb")
))
summary(fit_model2)
```

## Extracting SPDE Parameters

```{r}
spde_result <- spde_metric_graph_result(fit_model2, "field", spde_model)

result_df <- data.frame(
  parameter = c("kappa", "tau"),
  mean = c(spde_result$summary.kappa$mean, spde_result$summary.tau$mean),
  lower = c(spde_result$summary.kappa$"0.025quant", spde_result$summary.tau$"0.025quant"),
  upper = c(spde_result$summary.kappa$"0.975quant", spde_result$summary.tau$"0.975quant"),
  mode = c(spde_result$summary.kappa$mode, spde_result$summary.tau$mode)
)
print(result_df)

save.image("Data/5Fit_model2_alpha1_exact_50m_upd.RData")
```

## Posterior Distributions of Fixed Effects

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
library(ggplot2)

# Fixed effects summary table
fit_model2$summary.fixed

# Marginal posterior densities
marginals_fixed <- fit_model2$marginals.fixed
df_fixed <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(marginals_fixed), function(name) {
  m <- inla.smarginal(marginals_fixed[[name]])
  data.frame(parameter = name, x = m$x, y = m$y)
}))

ggplot(df_fixed, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~parameter, scales = "free", ncol = 4) +
  labs(x = "Value", y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Posterior Distributions of SPDE Parameters

```{r}
marginals_spde <- rbind(
  data.frame(
    parameter = "kappa",
    x = spde_result$marginals.kappa$kappa[, 1],
    y = spde_result$marginals.kappa$kappa[, 2]
  ),
  data.frame(
    parameter = "tau",
    x = spde_result$marginals.tau$tau[, 1],
    y = spde_result$marginals.tau$tau[, 2]
  )
)

ggplot(marginals_spde, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~parameter, scales = "free") +
  labs(x = "Value", y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Visualizing Model Results

We compare the estimated log-intensity surfaces from Model 1 (intercept + field only) and Model 2 (with covariates) side by side, using a shared color scale.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
library(scico)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(gridExtra)
library(cowplot)

# Common color range across both models (1st and 99th percentile)
log_lambda1 <- model1$graph_fitted_data$.linear_predictor
log_lambda2 <- fit_model2$graph_fitted_data$.linear_predictor
common_range <- quantile(c(log_lambda1, log_lambda2), c(0.01, 0.99))

p1 <- graph$plot_function(
  data = ".linear_predictor",
  newdata = model1$graph_fitted_data,
  vertex_size = 0, edge_width = 0.2,
  scale_color = scale_color_viridis(limits = common_range, oob = scales::squish)
) + ggtitle("Model 1") + theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "none")

p2 <- graph$plot_function(
  data = ".linear_predictor",
  newdata = fit_model2$graph_fitted_data,
  vertex_size = 0, edge_width = 0.2,
  scale_color = scale_color_viridis(limits = common_range, oob = scales::squish)
) + ggtitle("Model 2") + theme_minimal()

shared_legend <- cowplot::get_legend(p2)

png("Figures/model2_log_intensity_combined.png", width = 3300, height = 1500, res = 300)
combined_plot <- gridExtra::grid.arrange(
  p1,
  p2 + theme(legend.position = "none"),
  shared_legend,
  widths = c(10, 10, 1),
  layout_matrix = rbind(c(1, 2, 3))
)
grid::grid.draw(combined_plot)
dev.off()
```

### Estimated log-intensity for Model 1 (left) and Model 2 (right)

```{r, eval=TRUE, echo=FALSE}
knitr::include_graphics("Figures/New_5Graph_exact_vir__log_intensity_combined2.png")
```

### Posterior mean of $u(s)$ for Model 2

The latent Gaussian field $u(s)$ captures spatial variation not explained by the covariates.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
png("Figures/model2_posterior_u.png", height = 3 * 700, width = 3 * 900, res = 300)
p3 <- graph$plot_function(
  data = ".predicted_field",
  newdata = fit_model2$graph_fitted_data,
  vertex_size = 0, edge_width = 0.2,
  scale_color = scale_color_scico(palette = "vikO", midpoint = 0,
                                   limits = c(-2, 2), oob = scales::squish)
) + ggtitle(expression(~u)) + theme_minimal()
print(p3)
dev.off()
```

```{r, eval=TRUE, echo=FALSE}
knitr::include_graphics("Figures/New_5Graph_model2_alpha1_7FRC_pruned_exact_50m_posterior_u_vikO.png")
```
